claims.claim: SGLang documents DeepEP normal mode for high-throughput Prefill and low_latency mode for low-latency Decode/CUDA Graph workloads.
claims.notes: Mode selection remains workload and backend dependent.

claims.claim: SGLang separates dispatcher dispatch/combine from MoE runner computation and permutation stages.
claims.notes: Fused functions can replace middle stages for registered backend pairs.

claims.claim: The SGLang DeepEP V2 adapter constructs and caches an ElasticBuffer using process group, hidden size, Top-K and per-rank capacity in its cache key.
claims.notes: Pinned SGLang adapter imports ElasticBuffer from deep_ep.

claims.claim: DeepEP V2 dispatch validates token capacity, hidden size, scale-block alignment and Top-K width before communication.
claims.notes: Correctness constraints, not merely performance hints.

claims.claim: SGLang packages its ElasticBuffer integration as sgl-deep-ep and builds it from the sgl-project/DeepEP sgl-deepep branch.
claims.locator: dependencies: sgl-deep-ep==0.1.3; release-whl-deepep.yml checks out sgl-deepep
claims.notes: Package/release branch must be matched to the SGLang revision.

claims.claim: The separate sgl-deep-ep-v25 wheel follows the sgl-deepep-v25 branch; DeepEP V2.5 splits ElasticBuffer into EPBuffer, EngramBuffer, PPBuffer and BucketBuffer.
claims.locator: README / V2.5 release notes; SGLang release-whl-deepep-v25.yml
claims.notes: Do not assume the V2.5 package is a drop-in replacement for the ElasticBuffer package imported by this SGLang snapshot.

claims.claim: SGLang provides TBO, SBO and EPLB mechanisms to overlap work and address expert load imbalance.
claims.locator: Computation and Communication Overlap / Workload Balancer
claims.notes: Overlap requires preserving collective ordering and buffer lifetime.
